title: Unit Event — At The End of The Unraveled Thread — Episode5 As Cheerful * Days

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! is all set for their first TV appearance. However, the show's MC just happens to be the leader of the very group Shizuku used to be in, Cheerful * Days. As excited as she was about making their shoot a success, this surprise reunion has Shizuku...

rows.Line: A few months later
Shoot location

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for today.

rows.Speaker: TV Producer
rows.Line:
Shizuku, excellent work!
Your aura was as brilliant as ever today! I can see why everyone admires you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They admire me...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: TV Producer
rows.Line:
Also, you've been very busy lately!
Your manager said the other day that he's having trouble juggling all the shoots you're being asked to do...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
If I can help it, I'm trying to not refuse any offers...

rows.Speaker: TV Producer
rows.Line: That's completely fine since you're the it girl. Fortunately, I was able to book you, so I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, I'll be looking forward to our next shoot.

rows.Speaker: TV Producer
rows.Line:
Yes, likewise!
Again, I know you're busy, so try not to push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (My schedule really has been very full lately that it's dizzying...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Not too long ago, I never would've imagined being in this sort of situation. It must also be because of the producer's...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh no! Look at the time!
I need to get to my lesson!
Practice Space

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry for being so late!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
Hey, Shizuku.
You had that shoot for that show today, right?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: And you have to do that interview after practice, no? Talk about a tight schedule.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
I'm also glad that I'm being kept busy.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Yeah, Shizuku, your popularity's going through the roof! The producer came up with such a good plan for you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But that's not who I really am...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel, Shizuku.
I mean, having to essentially put on an act every time does seem pretty daunting.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
But it's working, right?
I feel like everyone's been talking about the “mysterious but perfect Shizuku” lately.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Your new persona's also probably why you've been getting so many offers.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But that's all because the producer always prepares a script for me and you're all there to back me up. I always make so many mistakes when I'm on my own...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Which is why I'm concerned...
Is this really the right way to go...?

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
What's wrong with that?
All your fans adore you because of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's not uncommon for people to play a character they've come up with.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm really not sure how long I can keep this up... I'm afraid that the real me is going to slip out one day...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I have to think that the producer's already taken that into consideration. Otherwise, I doubt he would've asked us to help.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I'm going to be honest, I also wasn't sure about this plan at first. But, if you becoming more popular means Cheerful * Days gets more attention...then I have no objections.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You know what they say. There's no such thing as bad publicity. Your popularity means the rest of the third generation also gets to enjoy the limelight!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Yeah, Shizuku, don't worry. We'll be right there to catch you if we see that you're about to fall!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After that, they kept their promise and saved me every time I was about to make a mistake...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I found comfort in knowing that they were there for me and I was very grateful for that... However, at the same time, I felt incredibly bad for them and tried to do what I can to be “perfect”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, that didn't go well, and those around me became my crutch...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I kept receiving more and more offers, and in time I had been asked to become the new lead...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not long after that, everyone slowly began to change their attitudes towards me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for being late!
My other shoot went on longer than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
How many times is that now...?
I thought you asked the manager to keep this from happening.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We ended up going off-script today and I didn't know what to talk about... Thank you for always being there to help me.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: You're welcome...? Seriously, when are you gonna learn to do things yourself? We're getting sick of having to play defense for you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, the final nail in the coffin was...

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Shizuku, is it true that you're not gonna be in our next show...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
It just happens to conflict with this live broadcast I'll be doing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As much as I want to prioritize our shows, they told me that they couldn't make any casting changes after they set this date.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: We get that work is work. Still...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: And you're okay with all this, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You have the most fans out of all of us, Shizuku, and many of them were looking forward to seeing you during our next show.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: How do you think they're going to feel when they find out that you're not going to be there? They can't refund their tickets, you know?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: What happens when they find out that you've put some TV offer before them?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-I know this isn't good.
But...

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Then, do something. Make it so you can actually perform in our show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But...
That other show airs very soon...

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
So, you're not gonna do anything?
What happened to being the lead?

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Okay, this has been on my mind for a while now. Is there really any point in you being in Cheerful * Days, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: You always leave early during practice to go do something else, while we work our butts off to make our fans smile during our shows.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: We didn't throw you all those lifelines just so you can keep appearing on TV and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
I know, right?
Seriously, what kind of lead are you? I've had it up to here with you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But... I...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I really am. And you're all right. I... I should've asked the staff sooner if there was anything we could do about this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been wondering ever since I was chosen to be the new lead... Am I really cut out for this...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wish someone else were chosen instead of...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Oh, just stop.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
You always do this.
You never think for yourself and just do as you're told.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You were given a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that the rest of us would do anything for, but you don't seem to care whatsoever about capitalizing on it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Arisa...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: And guess what? You're right. You're not cut out to be the lead. I agree with what everyone else said too.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: We had to do so much just to protect your precious persona. And only you get to reap the benefits.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I understand...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
No, you don't!
You have no idea what it's like for us to play second fiddle to you!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Despite all that, I took it. We all did because we wanted to keep doing shows for our fans...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: But you...!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You walk all over us like it's nothing... And now, even though you know how much it means to us, you're ducking out of our show...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I'm never going to forgive you for this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I knew that what I was given could only be maintained with the help of those around me. At least, I thought I did...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I wanted to give back to Cheerful * Days in any way that I could by working... I tried...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But after that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: W-Wait... Where's my stage outfit...?

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
Oh, is your outfit missing?
Probably because you appear in so few shows.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
Haha. Right?
You might want to remind the stylist that Shizuku Hinomori's actually going to perform today!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Things only got worse from there...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I became so overwhelmed by my own business that I couldn't do anything for the others...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You were given a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that the rest of us would do anything for, but you don't seem to care whatsoever about capitalizing on it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, that's why I agree with what Arisa and the others said.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no right being the lead in the first place. Especially since I couldn't do anything for the others and ended up leaving the group...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, since we've been given an opportunity to appear on TV alongside Cheerful * Days, I'd like to make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to make up for what happened back then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know it won't be easy, but I hope this clears the air between all of you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I don't think either party was wrong in this case.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Although, I can't condone what they said or the way they took their frustrations out on you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
However, they're idols...
They were probably feeling quite a lot of pressure to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree with you there...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I hope this shoot gives everyone from Cheerful * Days a chance to understand how you truly feel.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I would like that very much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to learn more about Shizuku's past, let's start practicing our responses to those questions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'll play the MC!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Umm, so...!
What are your favorite foods?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the first question you landed on after hearing Shizuku's story...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Maybe you should try answering some questions first, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
But I'm really sure that we're gonna be asked that!
